description.en_US: Shows whether osu!lazer is open, in the menus, playing a map, or between maps, as a hit-circle pill with an approach-circle animation, elapsed play time or cooldown countdown, and a hover popup with the current beatmap. Reads only the osu-state daemon's state file; nothing is detected by the module itself.
description.zh_TW: 以打擊圈樣式的膠囊顯示 osu!lazer 是開著、在選單、正在打圖還是剛打完：打圖時有 approach circle 動畫，旁邊顯示已打時間或冷卻倒數，hover 彈窗顯示目前的圖。只讀 osu-state daemon 的狀態檔，模組本身不做任何偵測。
description.zh_CN: 以打击圈样式的胶囊显示 osu!lazer 是开着、在菜单、正在打图还是刚打完：打图时有 approach circle 动画，旁边显示已打时间或冷却倒计时，悬停弹窗显示当前的图。只读 osu-state daemon 的状态文件，模块本身不做任何检测。
